steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Set post-expiry surrogate bidding to Off as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage whose Settings menu is used for this withdrawal.
Reach the Responses view specified by the case before opening Settings.
Submit the exact reason through the RFQ stage's Settings → Withdraw flow and capture Procol's response.
Verify that the RFQ stage is shown as Withdrawn after confirmation.
